_comment: Copy this file to manifest.json in the same folder and fill in REAL metadata for each source document you place here. Never invent URLs/dates/authorities for legal sources — leave a field blank/omit the document rather than guess.

patents_act_1970.pdf.title: The Patents Act, 1970 (Act No. 39 of 1970)
patents_act_1970.pdf.authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
patents_act_1970.pdf.summary: Primary Indian statute governing patentability, including Section 3(p) traditional-knowledge exclusion and Section 3(e) mere-admixture exclusion.

biological_diversity_act_2002.pdf.title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002
biological_diversity_act_2002.pdf.summary: Regulates access to Indian biological resources, ABS obligations, and NBA approval requirements for IPR filings.
